starting_state: One independent mustard-oil sample after prior preparation, initial prescribed shaking and an unshown separation interval; two visible layers. Planned 5 mL water plus 10 drops oil, not image-calibrated.
scope: Source step 4 soap-delivery excerpt for the mustard-oil tube only. Previous five-minute shaking and separation, subsequent shaking, other oil tubes and measured separation times are omitted.

clips.name: soap_delivery
clips.action: Deliver exactly two discrete drops of separately prepared stock A soap solution into the existing mustard-oil/water tube, keeping the tip above the open rim; stop after the second drop.
clips.state_before: One tube with a clear lower water layer and thin golden oil layer above, before soap addition.
clips.state_after: Two soap-stock drops have entered the same tube. The bulk layers remain until subsequent unshown shaking; no immediate complete emulsion or measured stability result is claimed.
